opening.quote: Good morning, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, my name is Joost.
opening.comment: You greeted the caller and gave your name and the company name, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: My name is Niamh do boy and my postcode is 3011 BD.
verification.comment: The caller gave full name and postcode, and you confirmed the match before discussing the account, which is correct.

understanding.quote: Customer: I just told you, €32.48 twice.
understanding.comment: The caller had already said the amount was charged twice, but you asked how much they were charged again, and the amount was also misheard as €32.40 when they said €32.48, so confirm the exact figure next time.

resolution_accuracy.quote: your bank will show it within 2 to 9 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says the duplicate charge refund shows within 3 to 5 working days, so the stated 2 to 9 range is wrong; also the amount discrepancy (€32.48 vs €32.40) was not resolved.

process_compliance.quote: I've refunded yeah the duplicate payment of €32.40 today
process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo or payments-team step applied here, and the same-day refund was done as required.

communication.quote: Sorry. Yes, I can see two payments of €32.40 far a pack off candles.
communication.comment: The apology was brief and the caller's mild irritation was acknowledged early, but the replies were curt and the final 'Right.' was abrupt; a warmer tone would help.

closing.comment: The call ended without confirming next steps or asking if there was anything else, so close with a clear summary and a polite sign-off.
